newsitem.title: USA: La Quinta Inns Inc Q4 shr flat at $0.11.
newsitem.headline: La Quinta Inns Inc Q4 shr flat at $0.11.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: 1996 Q4 includes a charge of $115,000 for extraordinary items and a $5.9 million provision for the premature retirement of assets, including the replacement of furniture and fixtures.
1995 Q4 includes a provision of $4.1 million for the premature retirement of assets.
1996 year includes a $524,000, or $0.01 a share, charge from extraordinary items and a $18.1 million provision for the retirement of assets.

1995 year includes a charge of $717,000, or $0.01 a share, for extraordinary items; $46.3 million, or $0.59 a share, in costs from the coversion of a partners interests into common stock; and a $12.6 million provision for the premature retirement of assets.
